plan.goal: Seed primary human hepatocytes onto the culture area of a 400 µm wide, 20 mm long channel.
plan.rationale: Primary human hepatocytes (phh) do not divide in vitro, so the seeding density must be set at the target working density directly. The physiology registry gives a seeding range of 100,000–200,000 cells/cm² for phh. The channel culture area is 400 µm × 20 mm = 0.08 cm². I chose the midpoint density of 150,000 cells/cm², giving 12,000 cells per channel (range 8,000–16,000). Primary human material warrants BSL-2 containment.
caveats: Primary human hepatocytes do not divide in vitro — seed at the target working density directly; there is no growth to fill the channel.
Primary human material requires BSL-2 containment per institutional policy.
Confirm the channel culture area is truly 0.08 cm² (400 µm × 20 mm) before seeding; a mm² vs cm² error is 100×.
Verify viability of the thawed hepatocyte suspension (trypan blue) before plating and correct the seed count for viability.
For a perfused channel, confirm the chosen shear (0.05–0.15 Pa hepatic range) is compatible with the flow you plan to run.
